decisions.reason: The black-finish line is a multi-model design range close to the core offer and central to the firm's design-led positioning, so the sunk investment and the brand commitment favour persisting even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The channel for seamless coverings has its own page and sits at the heart of the announced barrier-free bathroom direction, so this visible public commitment argues strongly for keeping it.

The pump-assisted line carried substantial development investment, and the launch of the related pump-drain channel F deepens the firm's commitment to this technology, so weak results would be read as a temporary ramp-up.
Launched only in 2024 and presented on its own page as an extension of the pump-drain strategy, it is too new and too visibly championed for management to drop it.
